note: mock_rate encodes the IDEAL outcome so `--decider mock` demonstrates the pipeline; real deciders (api/claude-cli) ignore it and measure the description. audit-summary is A-99: it reads finished audit reports and their findings registers and produces one prioritised register plus a top five for management. It never re-analyses code. The discriminators are input (finished audit reports, not the codebase) and output (a merged, deduplicated, dependency-ordered register), against reports (listing), report-export (reformatting one report) and task-summary (one delivered task).
